sql_templates.description: Fetch upcoming or recent corporate events and their related watchlist actions for the last 3 months.
sql_templates.template:
SELECT
    ce.symbol,
    ce.event_type,
    ce.event_date,
    ce.purpose_raw,
    ce.detail,
    ce.source,
    ra.period_end,
    ra.verdict,
    ra.growth_yoy_revenue_pct,
    ra.growth_qoq_revenue_pct,
    ss.trading_signal,
    ss.stage
FROM
    signals.corporate_events ce
JOIN
    scores.results_analysis ra ON ce.symbol = ra.symbol
JOIN
    scores.stage_snapshots ss ON ce.symbol = ss.symbol
WHERE
    ce.event_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months'
    AND ss.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
ORDER BY
    ce.event_date DESC
LIMIT 50;
